annotations.text:
Scan Barcode — Paribelle OMS

Two stations, one component:
Pack (outbound) and Goods in (inbound).

Matched to the running app: Inter,
#0ea5e9/#22d3ee sky pair, #f4f9fc
ground, 1rem panels, 0.75rem controls,
36rem modal — all lifted from
globals.css and modal.tsx.

Why the stations differ

Pack ends in one button: confirm, take
stock off, move to To ship.

Goods in ends in a question — did the
goods come back sellable? — because
restocking a worn return is how a used
item reaches the next customer. On
mobile that question IS the action bar.

Mobile: the sheet is the screen.
Viewfinder gets the space (it is what
you aim), the decision sits in the thumb
zone at 48-52px.

No painted status bar or fake keyboard —
the real ones render on top.

The cancelled state is the whole reason
a scan step exists between picking and
the courier, so it is the only one that
gets a heavy border and a 15px bold
line.

A duplicate scan is deliberately calm —
it is harmless, and nothing moved.
